description: This file defines the NamedRange class, which extends DefinedName, within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It manages named ranges in spreadsheets, allowing creation, retrieval, and manipulation of cell range references.

classes.name: NamedRange
classes.description: Represents a named range in a spreadsheet, allowing for defining, retrieving, and working with cell ranges, with support for scope and worksheet association.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new NamedRange object, requiring a name, optional worksheet, range, scope, and a flag for local-only scope.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Returns the cell range string associated with this NamedRange.

methods.name: setRange
methods.description: Sets the cell range string for this NamedRange.

methods.name: getCellsInRange
methods.description: Parses the range string and returns all cell references within that range as an array.
